name: team-slice
description: Run one DataObs team on a single owned work slice: branch, implement minimal change with tests, verify, open a focused PR, report the handoff contract. Does not merge. Cheapest unit of parallel delivery.

team_agent.description: The team agent to run, e.g. dataobs-team-1, dataobs-team-2, dataobs-team-5.

task.description: The concrete owned task with exit criteria and the exact files/paths in scope.

nodes.prompt:
Deliver this owned slice: ${task}

Branch <team>/<short-topic> from latest main. Implement the minimal owned change with the smallest proving tests. Verify with the smallest targeted gate (ruff/black or pnpm typecheck/lint/test as applicable) — do not re-run gates that already pass. Commit to the branch and open one focused PR. Report the handoff contract: owner, exact files, root cause/contract, tests + result, evidence, shared-path impact, dependencies, merge order. Do NOT merge, publish, or edit other teams' files. Follow credit-efficiency and parallel-delivery steering.
